Walking into the room was a moment of immediate regret. It was absolutely disgusting. The most immediate visual was the walls, which had large, dark patches of water seepage and dampness. The bedding was arguably worse; the sheets and pillowcases were a revolting, stained yellow, making it clear they were filthy and definitely not clean. I found the toilet to have a broken and cracked seat, and the bed was unstable and clearly broken, dipping severely. This was not just unclean—it was vile and made the entire stay feel deeply unsettling and unsanitary.

A Nightmare of Neglect: Filthy, Dangerous, and Uninhabitable

The room was in an extremely unhygienic and deplorable state. The walls were marred by visible seepage and mold. The bedding was appalling—the sheets and pillow covers were a sickening yellow hue, clearly not fresh. The furniture was damaged, featuring a broken, sagging bed and a cracked, broken toilet seat. This room should not be rented to guests.
